item.title: RTT: Rif. 6267_All. 5 - Linear analysis (Univ. BOLOGNA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-03 23:59
Institution: Univ. BOLOGNA, Bologna
Field: Mathematics and computer science / 01/MATH-03 Analisi matematica, probabilità e statistica matematica

Scientific research into current topics related to mathematical analysis, with particular reference to linear partial differential equations, L2 theory in several complex variables, hypoellipticity, geometric analysis in phase space, harmonic analysis with applications to complex and CR geometry, holomorphic function spaces, integral operators in harmonic analysis, differential equations and differential forms on Lie groups, potential theory, spectral theory. The RTT will undertake teaching activities in accordance with the University’s regulations

MUR listing

item.title: RTT: Ref. 6286_All. 11 - Mathematical Physics of Classical and Quantum complex systems (Univ. BOLOGNA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-03 23:59
Institution: Univ. BOLOGNA, Bologna
Field: Mathematics and computer science / 01/MATH-04 Fisica matematica

The project involves scientific research in Mathematical Physics on current topics in Classical Mechanics, Statistical Mechanics, and Quantum Mechanics, encompassing both theoretical and applied aspects of complex systems, with particular emphasis on Artificial Intelligence. The RTT will undertake teaching activities in accordance with the University’s regulations
